sources.title: img2img: Free Online Image-to-Image AI Generator
sources.snippet: Img2Img: Create a New Image from Any Image Use this AI image-to-image generator to turn a photo, artwork, product shot, or rough concept into a new image with a prompt. The source gives the request its subject and composition; your prompt can redirect the style, setting, materials, color, or lighting. Upload your source, describe the change, and generate a new result.
